text:
Ordering was deliberately left out of the Wolt plugin, and the user framed it as 'for now' rather than never.

Two reasons. The woltapi library's own README says the purchase path has never been tested with a real order: submit_prepared_order() only handles one restaurant, immediate home delivery and one saved card, and it is the call that actually charges you. Separately, this plugin is driven by an LLM, so any money-spending tool is one bad tool call away from a real charge.

If ordering is revisited, the library also lacks login, card enrollment, payment verification screens, scheduled orders, cancellation and refunds, and it needs browser/device information the caller has to supply itself. list_delivery_targets returns opaque IDs with no addresses, so a user cannot confirm where an order would go before submitting it.

The plugin also omits list_delivery_targets entirely for that same reason: opaque IDs are useless on their own.
